item.title: Perry Estate Hits Market: Tyler Perry lists $57m Beverly Hills mansion; once home to royal couple
item.description: Tyler Perry has listed his Beverly Hills mansion for $57 million amid plans to relocate to Puerto Rico. The estate, known for hosting Prince Harry and Meghan Markle, spans approximately 24,600 square feet. Featuring eight bedrooms and extensive amenities, it offers privacy within the exclusive Beverly Ridge Estates community. Perry developed the mansion over several years, completing it in 2012 after acquiring the land in 2004. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Nigeria Ebola patient and spouse admitted to hospitals in Switzerland
item.description: ⁠A woman infected with ⁠the Ebola virus and her husband, a ⁠Swiss diplomat, were flown from Nigeria to hospitals in Switzerland on Monday, Swiss authorities said. The Ugandan-born wife of the diplomat, based in Abuja, was being treated at Geneva University Hospitals for the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola, which has caused an outbreak that started in Democratic ‌Republic of Congo. Her husband, considered a close contact, was in isolation at University Hospital Zurich, the Swiss Federal Office of... Publicado también por: South China Morning Post. item.title: Scientists identify mushroom linked to visions of hundreds of tiny, colourful humans
item.description: The intriguing connection between the mushroom species Lanmaoa asiatica and hallucinations has come to light, particularly among users in China and the Philippines. Individuals describe encounters with small figures, a shared vision across multiple cultures. While the inquiry dates back to 1934, current advancements in identifying mushrooms provide fresh biological insights. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Pope in 'good health' and trip to South America will go ahead as planned
item.description: The Pope is recovering well from cancer surgery and his trip to South America will go ahead as planned next month, the Vatican has said. Fuente: Sky News - World.

item.title: El papa León XIV confirmó que viene a la Argentina: “Me llena de alegría regresar al continente”
item.description: El Sumo Pontífice ratificó la gira sudamericana que lo traerá al país el 8 de noviembre. También visitará Uruguay y Perú. El Vaticano detalló que la decisión se basó en la buena evolución que mostró a menos de dos semanas de haber sido operado por un cáncer de pulmón. "Alegría enorme", fue la reacción de Milei tras conocer la noticia. Publicado también por: Clarín - Mundo. Fuente: La Nación - El Mundo.
item.dc:creator: Elisabetta Piqué

item.title: El papa León XIV viajará a Argentina, Uruguay y Perú en noviembre tras recuperarse de una operación por cáncer de pulmón
item.description: El Vaticano confirmó que León XIV realizará su viaje apostólico a Uruguay, Argentina y Perú entre el 6 y el 17 de noviembre, tal como estaba previsto, tras una operación en la que le extirparon el lóbulo inferior del pulmón derecho. Los últimos exámenes médicos indican que no existen contraindicaciones para que el pontífice, de 71 años, emprenda la gira por Sudamérica. Fuente: France 24 - Español.
item.dc:creator: France 24

item.title: Fear and misinformation hamper Ebola response efforts in DR Congo
item.description: In eastern Congo, fear and misinformation are complicating the Ebola outbreak. After losing her sister and father, 27-year-old Zawadi Kavira Musubao was told she had been poisoned. A pastor blamed evil spirits, while a traditional healer’s potion failed to help. Fuente: Africanews.
item.dc:creator: editorial@africanews.com (Rédaction Africanews)

item.title: Vanessa Trump is cancer-free after breast cancer; reveals extreme fatigue was first sign of illness
item.description: Vanessa Trump has revealed that extreme fatigue was the first sign of her “very invasive” breast cancer, diagnosed six months ago. Now cancer-free after undergoing a lumpectomy and radiation treatment, she has shared details of her recovery and encouraged people to prioritise their health, schedule regular screenings and understand the importance of early detection. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Nigeria evacuates Ebola patient to Switzerland, tracks 53 contacts
item.description: The only confirmed case in Nigeria of Africa's latest deadly Ebola outbreak was evacuated Monday by air from Abuja, the capital, to Switzerland, where she has citizenship. Nigeria has stepped up contact-tracing and screenings at airports. Fuente: Africanews.
item.dc:creator: editorial@africanews.com (Rédaction Africanews)

item.title: ¿Alimentos que producen cáncer? Así opera la desinformación alimenticia en internet
item.description: Se ha vuelto recurrente en redes sociales ver posteos que dan recomendaciones sobre alimentación o advierten sobre el riesgo de consumir ciertas comidas, ya que podría provocar graves enfermedades. Sin embargo, estas publicaciones carecen de datos verificados por autoridades sanitarias, por lo que seguir alguna de estas recomendaciones virales podría implicar un riesgo para la salud. Este tema lo analizamos en Des-Informando. Fuente: France 24 - Español.

item.title: Ébola: responsables de la ONU condenan el asesinato de una enfermera en la República Democrática del Congo
item.description: Una enfermera que respondía a una alerta de ébola fue asesinada y otro trabajador sanitario resultó gravemente herido. "Condeno enérgicamente este ataque y pido una investigación exhaustiva", declara el coordinador de la ONU para el ébola, Julien Harneis, mientras la OMS recuerda que "la atención sanitaria debe protegerse siempre". El brote, el más mortífero de la historia de la RDC, suma ya más de 9760 casos y unas 4727 muertes y se ha extendido a ocho provincias. Fuente: Noticias ONU.

item.title: El "Culicoides", un insecto de apenas 2 mm que es el protagonista de propagar el virus Shamonda
item.description: Hasta hace apenas unos meses, el virus Shamonda era un patógeno considerado estrictamente animal que había sido detectado de manera esporádica en algunas zonas de África y Japón desde los años setenta. Sin embargo, su reciente y veloz irrupción en el continente europeo ha cambiado el paradigma epidemiológico, teniendo que plantear diferentes estrategias para mantenerlo bajo control. Un caso hizo saltar las alarmas la semana pasada , puesto que en Francia se detectó la primera infección por este virus en un humano, y concretamente por la variante europea SHAV-EU1. Esto ha hecho reevaluar el… Fuente: Xataka.

item.title: Scarlett Johansson buys $27.5M Manhattan penthouse for $13M
item.description: Scarlett Johansson and Colin Jost have purchased a co-op penthouse in Manhattan, which took seven years to sell. The property was initially listed at $27.5 million and underwent several price reductions before the sale. It spans 6,000 square feet and features numerous luxurious amenities, including six bedrooms and seven bathrooms. The previous owners had made extensive renovations before selling, which likely facilitated the eventual sale. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.description: Travellers entering Uganda after visiting DR Congo will face a 21-day quarantine, the country's health minister announced on Sunday. item.title: Beyoncé's childhood home in Houston finds buyer as fans flock to see the property
item.description: Beyonce's childhood home in Houston, Texas, found a buyer after being listed for $1.275 million in April 2026. Her family purchased the 1935 property in 1987 and lived there until 1994. The 4,010-square-foot house has undergone extensive renovations, including upgrades to its kitchen, bedrooms and outdoor spaces. Its connection to the singer attracted multiple offers and interest from fans across the United States. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: En 1518, cientos de personas empezaron a bailar sin control en Estrasburgo. La historia real es mucho más extraña
item.description: Si hay una epidemia que ha pasado a la historia, es la que ocurrió en Estrasburgo en 1518. En este punto, las leyendas que nos han llegado hasta nuestros días cuentan que entre 50 y 400 personas bailaron sin control durante días por las calles de la ciudad. Pero los relatos más dramáticos, apoyados en crónicas posteriores, afirman que esta frenética danza se cobraba la vida de hasta 15 personas al día. Hay dudas con los números. La historiadora Élisabeth Clementz ha querido revisar exactamente todo lo que ocurrió en este momento, y para ello consultó las fuentes más antiguas que tenemos. El… Fuente: Xataka.

item.title: Congo begins Ebola vaccine trial despite embedded outbreak
item.description: A pivotal trial of vaccines against the strain of Ebola that is driving a deadly outbreak across parts of Africa has begun in the Democratic Republic of Congo, where the epidemic originated and the vast majority of cases and deaths have occurred. The first participant was vaccinated on Friday in Bunia, eastern Congo, with Merck & Co.’s Ervebo shot, which has been approved to guard against a different Ebola species. An experimental alternative developed specifically against Bundibugyo by Moderna... Fuente: South China Morning Post.

item.title: ‘I can’t believe I get to see that’: One Born Every Minute is back for a 12th series
item.description: Reality TV show returns to focus on childbirth, diversity and the sharing of stories in a social media age When One Born Every Minute first aired in 2010, viewers loved its fly-on-the-wall take on life in a maternity unit, from midwives idly chatting about unusual pregnancy cravings to parents squabbling over whether to call their child Zeus. Almost two decades later, as the show is rebooted for a generation who spend their lives on social media, much has changed. Parents now share far more about their struggles with miscarriages, infertility and mental health; audiences have to be lured away… Fuente: The Guardian - World.
item.dc:creator: Rachel Hall

item.title: Dónal Lunny, ‘colossus of Irish music’, dies aged 79
item.description: Founding member of Planxty, Lunny went on to play for bands such as Moving Hearts, the Bothy Band and Coolfin The Irish traditional musician Dónal Lunny has died at the age of 79 from cancer. Lunny rose to prominence in the trio Rakes of Kildare alongside his brother Frank and Christy Moore. He went on to play in bands such as Planxty , Moving Hearts , the Bothy Band and Coolfin among others and toured the world. Continue reading... Fuente: The Guardian - World.
